description: Na₂CrH₂F₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.57 Å. Cr is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are four shorter (1.84 Å) and two longer (1.92 Å) Cr-F bond lengths. H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two F atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) H-F bond length. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one H atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one H atom.
